record.oneLiner: Command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram definition files to SVG, PNG or PDF.
record.verdictReason: A local CLI with no hosted API and no credentials, so there is nothing for an agent toolkit to authenticate against. Only third-party MCP servers exist (peng-shawn, not mermaid-js); the mermaid-cli README documents a Node.js API that is not covered by semver.

evidence.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid.
This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid.
It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that converts Mermaid diagrams to PNG images or SVG files.
